name: human-decision-v2
prompt: Edit this supporting infographic. Preserve exact composition, white background, palette, arrows, laptop, hands, magnifying glass and human reviewer. No text, digits or letters. Keep same 3:1 aspect ratio and generous margins. Everything else unchanged.
